listing.name: Yo-kai Watch 4++ (YW4Recomp)
listing.summary: Prepare your own Yo-kai Watch 4++ files with update 2.2.0 in the upstream Windows x64 or Linux x86-64 launcher. Earlier upstream testing reached the house and town and autosaved. Effects were missing and later areas could crash. Portcove has yet to qualify setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Provide the supported game edition
steps.instruction: Follow the publisher’s extraction guide for your own Yo-kai Watch 4++ with update 2.2.0. Use the required ExeFS and RomFS for the 4++ edition. The original Yo-kai Watch 4 requires a different profile.

steps.title: Choose a launcher package
steps.instruction: Choose the Windows launcher or Linux x86-64 AppImage. Prepare the owned game files through the upstream launcher and use its Update button for game updates. The separately listed game-update ZIP is for an existing launcher installation.

warnings: The publisher’s package metadata establishes download availability. Portcove has not confirmed runtime, save, platform or update behavior.
